name: Wilkes County, GA
findings: Wilkes County has 22 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wilkes County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Wilkes County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Wilkes County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
